title: Fixed Slotted Disc and Open Bridge Caliper Display
description: One newly authored complete static disc-and-caliper-style mechanical display. A full thin annular disc with twelve genuine through radial-sector slots joins a thick centre hub and fixed axle on a complete rear bearing pedestal. An independent whole bridge caliper wraps past the outer rim and holds two finite flat dark pads on opposite disc faces, with a deliberate open front inspection window showing the pad and blunt piston exterior. Two full guide bars and a rooted caliper support connect the whole mechanism to one low display plinth. The pads remain separated from the disc by a real fixed small gap, not a contact/force claim. New entire geometry, not the old cutaway drum/shoes flattened or a conical clutch relabelled. Three opaque PBR roles, one prop zero scenes. Fixed educational exterior only: no vehicle, hydraulic passages, fluid, friction rating, braking, rotation, actuation, load, installation, manufacturing or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
